page.overview:
Who is Ryohei Higashikata?

Ryohei is a middle-aged man with a square jawline, cleft chin, and graying hair, he has only been shown wearing a standard police officer outfit.

Ryohei is shown as having a humorous personality, even threatening Josuke with a fake gun as a form of a joke and ignoring a report to him due to the accused being his daughter. However, he was genuinely dedicated to protecting the public, something that Josuke admired about him.

Ryohei Higashikata was born around 1944 in Morioh. In 1964 he served as a police officer in Morioh for 35 years, one day in 1976 he managed to arrest a 12 year old robber and rapist criminal named Anjuro Katagiri.

Ryohei is first revealed as a police officer passing by on a bike. A man reports to him that the woman walking away had just assaulted him after he had asked to give her a ride and demanded that she be arrested. Ryohei refuses and explains that the woman that the guy cussed out was actually his daughter, Tomoko. Ryohei disregards the man's request and goes to accompany Tomoko home.
